comment: Human-editable scene file. Tweak room, camera, objects, or the prompt, then rerun the CLI on this .scene.json file. Leave prompt empty to rebuild it from the structured fields.

style.medium: Stylized 3D still, smooth shading, simple rounded silhouettes. Not photorealistic, not painterly, not pixel art.

style.materials: Pale oak hardwood or packed earth underfoot, cream plaster or timber walls, matte wood furniture.
style.lighting: Soft global illumination and warm daylight. No hard cinematic rim lights, no neon.
style.palette: Warm neutrals: cream, pale oak, charcoal accents, muted greens outdoors.
avoid: staircases unless the location mentions stairs
modern sofas, file cabinets, or extra furniture not listed
UI chrome, captions, watermarks, or readable text overlays
people unless an NPC is listed

scenes.prompt:
Create one still image of a single modest interior room named "Small House".

STYLE
Stylized 3D still, smooth shading, simple rounded silhouettes. Not photorealistic, not painterly, not pixel art.
Eye-level first-person view, slight wide angle, standing at the south side of the space looking inward.
Pale oak hardwood or packed earth underfoot, cream plaster or timber walls, matte wood furniture.
Soft global illumination and warm daylight. No hard cinematic rim lights, no neon.
Palette: Warm neutrals: cream, pale oak, charcoal accents, muted greens outdoors.
Avoid: staircases unless the location mentions stairs; modern sofas, file cabinets, or extra furniture not listed; UI chrome, captions, watermarks, or readable text overlays; people unless an NPC is listed.

CAMERA
Stand at the south side, look toward north. Eye height 1.5 m, FOV about 60 degrees.
Eye-level first-person view from the south, looking toward the north side of the location.

SPACE
You are in a small house. Sunlight filters through the window, illuminating a modest and cozy interior.
Approximate size: 5.5 m wide, 6.5 m deep, 2.6 m high.
Floor: Pale oak hardwood boards
Walls or edges: Cream plaster with simple timber trim
A window is implied on the west wall. Sunlight filters through this window onto the floor.

LIGHTS
- ambient (ambient): Soft fill so shadows stay gentle.
- sun (sun, from west): Warm daylight entering from the implied window.

PLACE THESE SUBJECTS AND NO OTHERS
NORTH (back wall from camera)
- North-facing door (exit, north): a heavy wooden north-facing door leading outside to the Clearing. Current state: status=closed, isOpen=false.
EAST (right)
- Pots and pans (prop, east): some pots and pans piled on the counter on the east side on an old table, with a wash basin and carafe of fresh well water near by Current state: status=dirty, isClean=false.
SOUTH (foreground / behind or beside camera)
- Late father's chest (prop, south): a chest that was owned by your late father, reinforced with iron bands and locked tightly. Current state: status=locked, isOpen=false, isLocked=true.
- Bed (prop, south): a modest bed on the south side of the room with a wool blanket and feathered pillow. Current state: isRested=false.
WEST (left)
- Coat rack (prop, west): a coat rack on the west side holding your late father's sturdy travel coat. Current state: status=hanging, coatTaken=false, isWorn=false.

Output a single 16:9 frame. No collage, no split screen, no caption.
